impact:
Reported from real use: "when I swap in a workout, I can't mark the sets complete. It always asks for another one after I complete the set. I want a button that says complete workout on it, or allows me to edit set count."

THE CAUSE IS NOT "NO COMPLETE BUTTON" — IT IS THAT A SWAPPED-IN EXERCISE HAS NO TARGET
A substitute joins the session as an ad-hoc exercise, deliberately (apps/web/src/screens/session/SessionScreen.tsx:302-305: the program day keeps the exercise it planned). Ad-hoc means `fromProgram: false`, and everything that decides "finished" is gated on that flag.

- apps/web/src/lib/session.ts:3 — `isExerciseDone = e.fromProgram && e.loggedSets.length >= e.targetSets`. For any ad-hoc exercise the first conjunct is false, so it is **never** done, whatever you log.
- apps/web/src/screens/session/SessionScreen.tsx:237 — a just-swapped exercise is built client-side with `targetSets: 0`.
- apps/web/src/screens/session/SessionScreen.tsx:389 — `pipCount = Math.max(active.targetSets, active.loggedSets.length + 1)`. With `targetSets: 0` that is always `loggedSets.length + 1`: exactly one empty pip, forever. **This is the "it always asks for another one" the report describes** — it is arithmetic, not a missing control.
- apps/api/src/routes/sessions.ts:197-201 — after the refetch the server rebuilds the ad-hoc entry with `targetSets: loggedSets.length` and `fromProgram: false`. The count stops reading 0, but `isExerciseDone` still cannot be true and pipCount still adds one.
- apps/web/src/screens/session/SessionScreen.tsx:481 — before that refetch the header reads `set 1 of 0`.

AND THE REPLACED EXERCISE IS STILL THERE
`swapTo` (SessionScreen.tsx:306-322) only adds the substitute and moves focus. The exercise being replaced stays in the day with its original target, still unfinished. So after one swap the session holds an exercise that can never be satisfied and another the user has no intention of performing — which is the other half of why it never resolves.

WHAT IS DELIBERATE AND MUST NOT BE BROKEN
CLAUDE.md records that `isExerciseDone` is false for ad-hoc exercises on purpose, so a freeform session stays focused on what was just added instead of declaring itself finished after one set. That rule is right for freeform. The defect is that a SWAP inside a program day inherits it, losing the target the program slot already stated.

THERE IS NO FINISH ACTION EITHER
The session screen's only terminal control is a "Review session" link (SessionScreen.tsx:873-877). Nothing says the workout is over, so even with every program exercise satisfied the screen keeps offering the next set.

VERIFIED vs SUSPECTED
Verified by reading: the isExerciseDone gate, `targetSets: 0`, the pipCount arithmetic, the API's ad-hoc mapping, and that swapTo does not remove the replaced exercise. Not reproduced at runtime — no swap was performed against a live session this session, only the resulting code paths read.

FIX DIRECTIONS (needs a decision, so this is a report not a plan)
1. Carry the target over: a swap performed on a program exercise gives the substitute that slot's targetSets/targetReps, so the session stays finishable. This addresses the actual report most directly.
2. Give ad-hoc exercises an editable set count, which is the user's own second suggestion and also serves freeform sessions.
3. A "Finish workout" action on the session screen, which is worth having regardless of 1 and 2 but does not by itself fix the never-done arithmetic.
Options 1 and 2 are not exclusive; 1 without 2 still leaves a freeform ride unfinishable.
resolution:
Took direction 1 — carry the target over — and modelled it properly rather than patching the arithmetic.

A mid-workout swap on a program exercise is now a **session substitution**: a new `session_substitution` table `(sessionId, programExerciseId, exerciseId)`, unique per slot, migration `0016_fresh_black_tarantula.sql`.

- `buildDayExercises` renders a substituted slot AS the substitute, carrying the slot's own targetSets / targetReps / targetRepsMax / targetDurationSec / restSec / note / section / supersetGroup, with `fromProgram: true`. So `isExerciseDone` and `pipCount` both work unchanged — no special case was added to either.
- `TodayExercise` gains `programExerciseId` (the handle a swap substitutes against, null for ad-hoc) and `substitutedFor` (the replaced exercise's name, rendered under the lift as "Instead of Back Squat").
- The replaced exercise no longer sits in the day unfinished — that was the second half of "it never resolves". Sets logged against it BEFORE the swap surface as an ad-hoc entry, which is honest: they were performed.
- `POST /api/sessions/:id/substitutions`. Naming the slot's own exercise deletes the row, which is the undo; there is no separate DELETE. A substitute another slot already holds is refused, because two slots sharing an exercise would share one pool of logged sets and each would read as the other's progress.
- The program day is untouched, preserving the design decision the issue flagged: next week still plans what it planned.
- `SessionScreen.swapTo` branches on `active.programExerciseId`: a program slot substitutes, an ad-hoc exercise keeps the old additive behaviour. Lazy session creation was extracted to `ensureSessionId` so a swap can be the first thing you do. `focusExercise` moved above the mutations so no `onSuccess` closes over a binding declared below the component's early returns.

RUNTIME VERIFICATION (against the running API with the seeded demo account)
- Substituting Bulgarian Split Squat for Back Squat returned the slot as "Bulgarian Split Squat | insteadOf Back Squat | targetSets 4 | targetReps 5 | rest 180", and Back Squat was gone from the day.
- Logging 4 sets made it read done 4/4 — the exact reported symptom ("it always asks for another one") is gone.
- Substituting Back Squat back restored the slot and left the 4 Bulgarian sets as an ad-hoc entry.
- `GET /api/programs` still shows Back Squat 4× in the Legs day throughout.
- Substituting Leg Press, already in that day, was refused with "Leg Press is already in this day."

Also clean: `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm --filter @afya/api test` (35 passed), and `db:migrate` against the local database.

NOT FIXED HERE, filed as ISS-014: directions 2 and 3 — an editable set count for ad-hoc exercises and a "Finish workout" action. A freeform session still cannot read as finished, and CLAUDE.md records that `isExerciseDone`'s `fromProgram` requirement is deliberate for freeform, so changing it is a design decision of its own rather than part of this fix. CLAUDE.md now carries a "Mid-workout Swaps (session substitutions)" section recording why a program slot must never get an ad-hoc stand-in.
title: A swapped-in exercise has no set target, so the session always asks for one more set and can never be finished
